metadata.notes: If only it were this easy.  61 Across: The original Prussian name for STOLLEN was Striezel, from a word meaning 'awaken'.  The cake was intended to represent baby Jesus wrapped in swaddling clothes.  A 'smaller' stolen ___ 30-odd pounds ___ was for many years part of a holy Christmas celebration.  In 1730, August the Strong ordered a giant stolen ___ nearly two tons ___ so that everyone could have a piece.  That tradition still exists in modern-day Dresden, known as Stollenfest.
